48.original: Lali-just the sinner I've been looking for-ho.

49.original: Another one of those recording devices has arrived from Konogg. Seems the lad has more he wants to say to you. Here.

50.original: When you have a moment, be sure to see what's on it.

52.original: Yes, the two of you! What are you doin', talkin' and noddin' suspiciously!? What are you up to!?

53.original: <gasp> You're conspirin' to take over the village, aren't you!? Just like those murderous machines!

54.original: Huh? What am I...? What did I just...? Unnngh, my head...

55.original: Something's not right with Glagg. And it's not quite the same sort of “not right” what follows a few too many casks of ale...

56.original: Well, whatever it is, it's nothing you need to worry about. I'll take care of it.

57.original: Now then, was there something else you needed?

59.original: Is there anything I can help with?

63.original: You... What do you want? If you're here to mock us, have done with it and leave us be.

64.original: N-No, I'm not here to mock you. On the contrary, I want to join you.

65.original: I'm usually not one to get involved, preferring to observe from a safe distance while making the occasional comment to remind people of my presence. But seeing how hard you've been working for the village, I couldn't help but want to make myself useful for a change.

66.original: Well, we could certainly use all the help we can get... What say you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Shall we welcome him to the crew?

67.original: Thank you! I'm certain you won't regret it!

68.original: After that strangeness with Glagg, I wasn't sure what to expect from our dour friend, but it sure wasn't an offer of help.

69.original: Anyway, I'll find a moment to talk with the fellow about our plans. And when he's managed to settle in, you ought to have a word with him too.

70.original: But to answer your earlier question─there's nothing we need you for right now. Only a matter of time before we call on you again, though, so kick your feet up while you can.

72.original: A weekly quest which continues the story is now available from the dour dwarf in Komra.

73.original: Lend your aid and help the dwarves of Komra to rebuild their home.

74.original: You obtain a message from Konogg.

75.original: The message can be viewed in your <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Portable Archive<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>, which is available under Collection in the Duty section of the main menu.
